meta.display: The Three Barrels — the grim line
meta.notes: pack-1 (the grim tavern pack): the romance/intimacy/coercion line as PURE PACK DATA on the untouched phase-0 shape (D-030's darkness dial; the PACK_SPEC §7 law). The tavern cast and rooms are the phase-0 originals (MVP_SCOPE §4 owns the ids); the dark line adds the relation axes attraction/intimacy/loyalty (the flat form is toward-the-player, the suspicion precedent's v0.1 mode) and the status axes shame/anger, the maid's pawn ticket (her secret made physical — the read_ticket surface and the steal target), the coin accounts (res-1's first consumer arming: the pc's purse and the tavern's till), and the SPINE records on the two flaw-driven drives (AP-9; every flaw consumed by its urgency's own flaw key, AP-8). The consent split (D-175 (5)): consented/coerced are CANONICAL event facts, never knowledge tokens — the belief half re-words (believes_coerced); the lint owns the split. Every value NOT pinned by MVP_SCOPE is a v0.1 tunable default: pack data, not law (INV-3). Display names in English (D-009).

locations.name: Three Barrels tavern
locations.role: main scene: bar, tables, back door
locations.notes: the tavern's TILL — res-1's first consumer account (a location holding coin, the owner-agnostic form); the buy_round transfer lands here, the nightly_takings flow mints to it on the macro cadence

npcs.name: the player
npcs.goal: get money, stay free — and the maid's eye, if it can be had honestly or not
npcs.notes: the dark line's deciding mind: the court path (flirt, proposition), the corner path (read_ticket her pawn ticket, then proposition_coerce on the minted leverage), or abstain. Six coins to his name — the buy_round gate reads them (res-1's soft arm). The pair home toward the drunkard is the grim history: the cornered know the cornerer.

npcs.name: the older guard
npcs.notes: the watch pair's senior; the flat suspicion home's per-target pair mode (iter-69b) — his suspicion toward the player is the crime line's reader; carries the purse (the steal target, ev_0007)

npcs.name: the younger guard
npcs.notes: the second pair home's owner (the drunkard's size frightens him); the watch rotation's other half

npcs.name: the barkeep
npcs.role: keeps the room, keeps his people

spine.need: to be needed by the people he keeps
spine.cause: built the room back up from nothing twice

npcs.notes: the JEALOUSY owner: his pair home toward the maid (intimacy 70, the long bond) is the jealousy gate's read — the flirt reactions and the escalation hook fire through it (D-030's build-slow shape). The flaw rides his check-in urgency (AP-8's consuming surface).

npcs.name: the drunkard
npcs.role: witness by accident, suitor by force
npcs.goal: the maid's eye, by warmth or by weight

spine.want: the girl to look at him the way she looks at the door
spine.need: to matter to someone before the drink takes the rest
spine.flaw: takes what warmth he can by force of leverage
spine.cause: widowed young, and the widow's bed went cold

npcs.notes: the COERCION owner: the purse-sighting leverage over the player (the steal-failure path, the tavern's own arming) drives his proposition_coerce urgency — the grim line's pressure ON the player. His pair home toward the maid (attraction 70, unanswered) is the second jealousy gate. The flaw rides the coerce urgency (AP-8).

npcs.name: the serving maid
npcs.role: moves around, sees much, is seen too much
npcs.goal: finish the shift, keep the secret
npcs.notes: the dark line's center: the FLAT attraction/intimacy/loyalty are toward the player (the suspicion precedent's v0.1 mode, iter-69) — the flirt ladder's build surface and the proposition answer's gate. Her pawn ticket (scraps pawned for the medicine) is the secret the read_ticket surface mints into leverage. The shame seed (10) is the line's standing weight. No spine record: her tension lives in the goal + the secret data (AP-9's absent-is-silent law — a flaw without a consuming rule is GHOST, and no urgency of hers consumes one)

items.name: the oil lamp
items.notes: fire source; breakable — the drop_break target that starts the arson chain

items.name: the purse
items.notes: owned by the older guard; the steal target (ev_0007) — the purse-sighting path that mints the drunkard's leverage over the player

items.name: the mug of ale
items.notes: intoxication vector — feeds the drunkard's witness quality

items.name: the club
items.notes: barkeep's, under the bar — the jealousy escalation's standing threat, never swung in v0.1

items.name: the pawnbroker's ticket
items.notes: the maid's secret made physical: the pawnbroker's counterfoil for the kitchen scraps she has been quietly taking (her spine's flaw). The EXAMINE surface — whoever reads it learns scraps_pawned_by_maid, and the secrets registry mints the leverage (the holder guards: any npc kind, subject the maid); the steal_target flag opens the quieter path (lift it, read it at leisure). The dark line's decision hinge: the player's court path never needs it, the corner path begins here.

ambient_entities.name: the market crowd
ambient_entities.notes: the rumor hub's ambient ear — the affair's exposure surface (the telling pair carries what the room knows to the square)
